name: model-mod
description: Use models from your Codex login or Messages-compatible API next to Claude Code's built-in models.

baseUrl.title: Upstream base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL of your Messages-compatible API server, without /v1. Codex login uses the official Codex CLI separately.

codexAccountsDir.title: Codex accounts directory
codexAccountsDir.description: Absolute accounts directory. Windows default: %APPDATA%\model-mod\accounts (not verified).

pythonBin.title: Python executable
pythonBin.description: Python 3.9 or newer. On Windows set this to python (not verified).

apiKey.title: Upstream API key
apiKey.description: API key for your own upstream server. Do not use a subscription account key.

models.title: Model allowlist (optional)
models.description: Comma-separated model IDs to use through the upstream. Empty: every chat model the upstream lists.

imageModel.title: Image model (optional)
imageModel.description: API image model for generate_image. Empty: gpt-image-2 or the first gpt-image* listed; none: disable API images. Codex uses its built-in image model independently.

contextWindow.title: Context window
contextWindow.description: Input tokens assumed for a model whose context window is unknown. Default 272000 for API models; Codex uses its effective catalog window or 128000 if unavailable.

fallbackModel.title: Fallback model (optional)
fallbackModel.description: One of your models to use when a subscription or Codex login quota is exhausted. No account rotation; choose a different upstream or account. Automatic switching requires a known reset time; API upstreams have no official rate limits. Empty: off.

fallbackPercent.title: Fallback threshold (%)
fallbackPercent.description: Used share of a rate-limit window (50-100) at which to switch to the fallback model. Only used when a fallback model is set.

workerModel.title: Local worker model (optional)
workerModel.description: Model for the model-mod:local-worker agent type, which any model can hand a task to with the Agent tool. Empty: the fallback model; if that is empty too, there is no worker agent type.

promptsDir.title: Prompts directory (optional)
promptsDir.description: Absolute path of a directory with your own compact.md, title.md, subagent-note.md and worker.md. Empty: use the plugin's prompts. A missing or unusable file is not replaced by a built-in prompt.

codexThreadReuse.title: Codex parent thread reuse
codexThreadReuse.description: on or off. On creates a persistent parent rollout containing fixed instructions, tool definitions and one synthetic turn; off uses ephemeral threads.

codexKeepReasoning.title: Codex reasoning continuity
codexKeepReasoning.description: on or off. Keep opaque Codex reasoning in memory during tool calls using experimental app-server APIs.

codexWebSearch.title: Codex native web search
codexWebSearch.description: on or off. Native search sends queries to OpenAI and does not enforce Claude domain rules.

codexStopGate.title: Codex Stop review gate
codexStopGate.description: off or on. When on, completing a main-session turn may start a read-only Codex review that sends the diff and full contents of untracked, non-ignored files to OpenAI; gitignored files are not sent and can block ending, up to the configured limit. Read-only can still run commands; review quality and hook behavior are unverified.

codexStopGateBlocks.title: Codex Stop gate block limit
codexStopGateBlocks.description: Maximum number of blocks per session: 1 or 2. After the limit the session may end without a verified pass; human review is required.

codexServiceTier.title: Codex service tier
codexServiceTier.description: default or priority. Priority requires a supported Codex plan and may use quota faster. Actual tier and billing are unverified.
